text:
Maya Chen: Quick check — RedShift renewal in 3 weeks. Procurement pushed a pricing change request (asking for ~10% off seats) and the signer changed to their Finance Dir (no SSO). PO is delayed and legal flagged our KMS clause. Can CS Ops own execution plan? @Sam
Sam Patel: On it. Do we have an updated quote with seat true-up language and a fallback term? I can spin one. Who's the legal reviewer?
Jordan Rivera: Legal reviewer is @Lee. I pinged procurement this morning — they said signer is out until Monday but will accept DocuSign if we resend a PO template. I can chase Helen.
Lee Kim: Saw the legal note — we can keep KMS/HSM but narrow the scope in an addendum. Will draft suggested wording.
Maya Chen: Two asks: (1) Sam — new quote with separate lines: base seats + anticipated true-up seats + optional 10% discount line so procurement can toggle. (2) Jordan — confirm signer contact + billing entity. Also capture PR# if they need internal approvals.
Sam Patel: Will create quote by EOD. I’ll include options for 9mo vs 12mo terms and a 10% discount line item as requested.
Jordan Rivera: Reached Helen — she confirmed DocuSign is fine and asked for a PO template with our remit info and their billing code. Left a note in #cs-ops-docs with her contact.
OpsBot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example/abc123 (expires in 7 days). Envelope ID: 0xDF4.
Maya Chen: Heads up — if PO slips past renewal date, ops prefers 14d auto-grace before enforcement to avoid app disruption. Is that acceptable?
Lee Kim: Legal concurs with a 14-day operational grace if we require outreach logs and a signed addendum to re-enable access. Add exact wording to quote: "Operational grace period: 14 days post-term before service suspension."
Sam Patel: Quote uploaded: s3://quotes/redshift/5478901111-quote-v2.pdf — includes 9mo/12mo pricing, KMS addendum note, and discount toggle.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll follow up with Helen for signer details and routing, track PO status, and update this thread hourly. I'll also log PR# and vendor code once I have it. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: Ping me if procurement asks for net terms adjustment — I can recalc.
Jordan Rivera: I'll escalate if I don't hear back by COB tomorrow.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — keeping this here so renewals + legal + ops can follow.
